p='src/chat_input.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old="""                // The line along the bottom of the gap, as wide as what is left
                // of it, so there is none once Code and Spec meet.
                let gap_line = gpui_kit::TestSupportExt::test_support(
                    div()
                        .id("chain-gap-line")
                        .absolute()
                        .bottom_0()
                        .left(-gap)
                        .w(gap)
                        .h(px(1.))
                        .border_b_1()
                        .border_color(border),
                );"""
new="""                // The line along the bottom of the gap, beneath the chain while
                // it sits apart, as wide as what is left of the gap, so there is
                // none once Code and Spec meet. Drawn as every tab bar draws its
                // line, the bottom border of a box the bar's full height: a box
                // no taller than its own border has no inside, and the renderer
                // draws nothing of it.
                let gap_line = gpui_kit::TestSupportExt::test_support(
                    div()
                        .id("chain-gap-line")
                        .absolute()
                        .top_0()
                        .bottom_0()
                        .left(-gap)
                        .w(gap)
                        .border_b_1()
                        .border_color(border),
                );"""
assert s.count(old)==1; s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

content.text:
The Chain tab now gets the same bottom line as any other unselected tab when it isn't active. When it's active (combined mode) there's still no line. All 222 tests pass (1 ignored), both builds have no warnings, and the piton checks and build pass. I haven't checked it in the running app.

**Cause:** in my last fix, the line under an inactive Chain was a box 1px tall with a 1px bottom border. gpui's renderer only draws a bottom border in the bottom half of a box. So on scaled displays that line came out thinner than the lines under the other tabs, or missing entirely.

**Fix** (`src/chat_input.rs`): the line is now drawn the way gpui-kit draws every tab bar's line, as the bottom border of a full-height box. It's still exactly as wide as the gap between Code and Spec, so it disappears when they join under Chain.

**So it stays fixed:**
- **Rasterizer:** the one tests use to draw frames into pixels (`src/frame_image.rs`) now follows the renderer's rule for which pixels get a border. Before, it drew the old 1px line in full, so tests couldn't see the problem.
- **Test:** the full-window test now requires the pixels under an inactive Chain to match those under the inactive Ask tab exactly. It checks light and dark mode, scales from 1x to 2x, and a range of window heights. It still requires no line under Chain when combined.
- **Mutation check:** with the old 1px line put back, the test fails at 1.75x.

I also updated the spec: when Chain is inactive, its line must match the other unselected tabs' in colour, thickness and position at any display scale.
